description: MetaRalph Phase 13: Full Autonomy Mode - Continuous operation with minimal supervision, adaptive scheduling, resource optimization.

userStories.title: Implement adaptive work scheduling
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to optimize when and what I work on based on patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Learns optimal times for different task types
Prioritizes based on: user activity patterns, urgency, dependencies
Avoids scheduling during user's active coding sessions
Adapts schedule based on success rates by time of day

userStories.title: Implement resource optimization
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to optimize API usage and compute resources.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracks API token usage per task type
Predicts resource needs based on task complexity
Implements smart caching for repeated operations

userStories.title: Implement autonomous decision making
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to make more decisions autonomously based on learned patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Gradually increases autonomy for consistently approved task types
Reduces autonomy for frequently rejected proposals
Confidence threshold adjusts based on learning
User can override autonomy levels per project/type

userStories.title: Implement proactive communication
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to proactively update users on important events.
acceptanceCriteria: Sends daily/weekly summary of work completed
Alerts on: failures, blocked tasks, pending approvals
Notification channels: CLI on next open, optional email/Slack

userStories.title: Implement continuous improvement metrics
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track and optimize my own performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracks: tasks completed, success rate, time to completion, user satisfaction
Creates self-improvement tasks to address issues
Dashboard shows: MetricsView with trends and insights

userStories.title: Implement full autonomy coordinator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to operate continuously with minimal supervision.
acceptanceCriteria: Self-heals from failures without user intervention
